out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials (container of degreaser and multiple chemical spray bottles) are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food contact equipment (multiple cutting boards) on shelf under prep sink in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EHS instructed CFM to relocate all cutting boards to shelf away from chemical storage.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: plastic squeeze bottles (oil, water, sauce), plastic containers of seasonings/ spices/ dry goods (salt, soma, simple syrup, etc.), and bulk bins (dry rice and breadcrumbs).
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to place common food label on all food items removed from original container.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: multiple metal tongs stored hanging off the side of equipment on the prep and cookline and scoop handles directly touching dry rice and bread crumbs in bulk bins in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM relocated scoop handles out of the bulk rice and bread crumbs and relocated tongs to chlorine dish machine to be cleaned/ sanitized before storing on clean food contact surfaces between use.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed ice bin that has been cleaned not stored covered or inverted on top of ice machine in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM inverted ice bin.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface:aluminum foil lining shelf under prep sink in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS advised CFM to removed aluminum for easy access for cleaning. SERAY (Inspection Date: 09/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: uncooked diced lamb stored directly above uncovered uncooked shrimp and whole fish inside the US 2 DRW under counter (Under the stovetop) refrigerator on the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CFM relocated reverse the order of the arrangement of food in the refrigerator (uncooked whole fish and shrimp on top and uncooked diced lamb on bottom shelf.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chlorine sanitizing glass machine in the bar area was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm (0- 50ppm) chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CDI: CFM agreed to discontinue using chlorine sanitizing glass cleaner in the bar area until serviced.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: white encrusted accumulation on the espresso steam wand in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized the espresso steam wand.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: multiple packs of frozen calamari rings thawing on rolling cart in the kitchen near 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: CFM relocated packs of frozen calamari rings to the prep sink to continue thawing under cool (70F or lower) running water.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed ice bin stored on top of ice machine that have been cleaned not covered or inverted in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: CFM inverted the ice bin on top of clean surface of the ice machine.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: accumulation of dust around the exterior frame of the ice bin door in the kitchen area..
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CDI: CFM cleaned around the exterior frame of the ice machine in the kitchen.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device (“Y” splitter ) on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM agreed to remove one hose from the “Y splitter”. SERAY (Inspection Date: 03/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Observed no heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. EHS instructed CFM to obtain high temperature dishmachine thermometer or test strips

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.
